text:
jenna: Quick sync — vendor asked for our modeling inputs for capacity mix and billing cadence. Need hard numbers: supply windows, min commit, spot multipliers, marketplace fee %. @corey @sanjay can you share partner-level inputs? cc @marie for marketplace fees.
corey: CoreWeave prelims — reserved lead time 30d, min commit 3mo, reserved price GPU/month = $1,200 (A100 equiv). Spot avg = 0.24x reserved, spot volatility ~±35% month-to-month. Can share contract excerpt.
sanjay: Nebula numbers — lead time 14d, min commit 1mo, reserved = $950/mo, spot avg = 0.38x but APAC +20% on spot. They have "burst credits" allowing extra ephemeral up to 20% of committed in peak windows.
ali: Marketplace fees — standard partners = 8% marketplace take, payout net-90. Also there is a 0.5% payment processing add-on for some regions. Need to decide whether to bake into unit cost or list separately.
partners_bot: Upload complete — contracts: CW-2026-Q1.pdf, NB-2026-spotclause.pdf (stored to S3, link shared in #secure-files). :white_check_mark:
corey: Note we measured a scheduling overhead ~7% (lost cycles). For modeling include a scheduling inefficiency multiplier 1.07. I'll upload per-region supply curves CSV.
jenna: For consistency please return inputs using this schema (fill values):
```json
{
  "partner": "string",
  "region": "string",
  "reserved_price_per_gpu_month_usd": "number",
  "min_commit_months": "number",
  "reserved_lead_time_days": "number",
  "spot_multiplier_vs_reserved": "number",
  "spot_volatility_pct": "number",
  "burst_pct_of_reserved": "number (0-100)",
  "scheduling_overhead_pct": "number",
  "marketplace_fee_pct": "number"
}
```
sanjay: Filling that now and sending back. Quick Q — should we present spot as a multiplier vs reserved or as an absolute $/GPU-hour? I vote multiplier so the finance model can apply utilization hypotheses.
ali: +1 multiplier in raw data, but finance should compute and show both absolute $/GPU-hr and blended per-token metrics at 25/50/75% utilization for sales.
corey: CSV attached to thread: s3://redwood-partners/cw_supply_curves_q1.csv — includes per-hour curves, reserved buckets, and regional deltas. Also adding notes about sustained-use discounts.
marie: FYI marketplace team: if we list partner pricing in the portal we need a 14-day rollback window and a documented revenue share memo. That changes legal review cadence.
jenna: Great progress. Action items: @corey attach contract clause screenshot + CSV, @sanjay send filled JSON, @ali confirm how marketplace fee displayed (baked vs separate), @marie confirm legal review ETA. Target final inputs by EOD or latest tomorrow 11am PT. :thumbsup:
corey: Got it — aiming EOD.
jenna: Thanks all — will feed into cost model and share slides for GTM with blended examples.
